import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- All targets in range
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Unique targets (simple graph)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

def WeightedGraph.path_has_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (w_total : Int) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | [] => w_total = 0
  | [_] => w_total = 0
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      ∃ w_edge w_rest,
        g.has_edge u v w_edge ∧
        g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) w_rest ∧
        w_total = w_edge + w_rest

def WeightedGraph.is_path (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  match p with
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      (∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) ∧ g.is_path (v :: rest)

-- Shortest path predicate
def WeightedGraph.is_shortest_dist (g : WeightedGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ g.path_has_weight p d) ∧
  (∀ p w, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → g.path_has_weight p w → w >= d)

-- Negative cycle predicate
def WeightedGraph.has_negative_cycle (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p w, g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast? ∧ g.path_has_weight p w ∧ w < 0

def WeightedGraph.weights_and_size_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bellman_ford_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  start < graph.size ∧
  graph.weights_and_size_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

namespace BF

/-- Add an edge weight to a possibly-infinite (`none`) label. -/
def addO (a : Option Int) (w : Int) : Option Int :=
  match a with
  | none => none
  | some x => some (x + w)

/-- Minimum in `Option Int` where `none` is `+∞`. -/
def combine (a b : Option Int) : Option Int :=
  match a, b with
  | none, x => x
  | some x, none => some x
  | some x, some y => some (min x y)

/-- `a ≤ b` in the order where `none` is `+∞`. -/
def leO (a b : Option Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ y, b = some y → ∃ x, a = some x ∧ x ≤ y

/-- All incoming edges of `v`, as `(source, weight)` pairs. -/
def edgesInto (g : WeightedGraph) (v : Nat) : List (Nat × Int) :=
  (List.range g.size).flatMap (fun u =>
    ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.filter (fun p => p.1 = v)).map (fun p => (u, p.2)))

/-- Reverse adjacency table, computed once. -/
def inTable (g : WeightedGraph) : List (List (Nat × Int)) :=
  (List.range g.size).map (fun v => edgesInto g v)

/-- Relax the label of one vertex along all of its incoming edges. -/
def relaxList (d : List (Option Int)) : List (Nat × Int) → Option Int → Option Int
  | [], acc => acc
  | e :: rest, acc => relaxList d rest (combine acc (addO (d.getD e.1 none) e.2))

/-- One full relaxation round. -/
def stepBF (g : WeightedGraph) (tbl : List (List (Nat × Int))) (d : List (Option Int)) :
    List (Option Int) :=
  (List.range g.size).map (fun v => relaxList d (tbl.getD v []) (d.getD v none))

def initBF (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : List (Option Int) :=
  (List.range g.size).map (fun v => if v = start then some 0 else none)

/-- State after `k` relaxation rounds. -/
def iterBF (g : WeightedGraph) (tbl : List (List (Nat × Int))) (start : Nat) :
    Nat → List (Option Int)
  | 0 => initBF g start
  | k + 1 => stepBF g tbl (iterBF g tbl start k)

end BF
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def bellman_ford (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : bellman_ford_precond graph start) : Option (List (Option Int)) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let tbl := BF.inTable graph
  let d1 := BF.iterBF graph tbl start (graph.size - 1)
  let d2 := BF.stepBF graph tbl d1
  if d2 = d1 then some d1 else none
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bellman_ford_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (result : Option (List (Option Int)))
    (_ : bellman_ford_precond graph start) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some dists =>
      dists.length = graph.size ∧
      ∀ v, v < graph.size →
        match dists.getD v none with
        | some d => graph.is_shortest_dist start v d
        | none => ¬ ∃ p, graph.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v
  | none =>
      graph.has_negative_cycle
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

namespace BF

lemma leO_refl (a : Option Int) : leO a a := by
  intro y hy; exact ⟨y, hy, le_refl y⟩

lemma leO_trans {a b c : Option Int} (h1 : leO a b) (h2 : leO b c) : leO a c := by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := h2 y hy
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := h1 x hx
  exact ⟨z, hz, le_trans hzx hxy⟩

lemma combine_le_left (a b : Option Int) : leO (combine a b) a := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> intro y hy <;> simp_all [combine]

lemma combine_le_right (a b : Option Int) : leO (combine a b) b := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> intro y hy <;> simp_all [combine]

lemma combine_eq (a b : Option Int) : combine a b = a ∨ combine a b = b := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [combine]
  rename_i x y
  rcases le_total x y with h | h
  · left; omega
  · right; omega

lemma relaxList_le_acc (d : List (Option Int)) (ins : List (Nat × Int)) (acc : Option Int) :
    leO (relaxList d ins acc) acc := by
  induction ins generalizing acc with
  | nil => simpa [relaxList] using leO_refl acc
  | cons e rest ih =>
      simp only [relaxList]
      exact leO_trans (ih _) (combine_le_left _ _)

lemma relaxList_le_mem (d : List (Option Int)) (ins : List (Nat × Int)) (acc : Option Int)
    (e : Nat × Int) (he : e ∈ ins) :
    leO (relaxList d ins acc) (addO (d.getD e.1 none) e.2) := by
  induction ins generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp at he
  | cons f rest ih =>
      simp only [relaxList]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with h | h
      · subst h
        exact leO_trans (relaxList_le_acc _ _ _) (combine_le_right _ _)
      · exact ih _ h

lemma relaxList_cases (d : List (Option Int)) (ins : List (Nat × Int)) (acc : Option Int) :
    relaxList d ins acc = acc ∨
      ∃ e ∈ ins, relaxList d ins acc = addO (d.getD e.1 none) e.2 := by
  induction ins generalizing acc with
  | nil => left; simp [relaxList]
  | cons f rest ih =>
      simp only [relaxList]
      rcases ih (combine acc (addO (d.getD f.1 none) f.2)) with h | ⟨e, he, h⟩
      · rw [h]
        rcases combine_eq acc (addO (d.getD f.1 none) f.2) with h2 | h2
        · left; exact h2
        · right; exact ⟨f, by simp, h2⟩
      · right; exact ⟨e, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he, h⟩

lemma getD_map_range {α : Type} (f : Nat → α) (v n : Nat) (hv : v < n) (dflt : α) :
    ((List.range n).map f).getD v dflt = f v := by
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
  simp [hv]

lemma mem_edgesInto (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) :
    (u, w) ∈ edgesInto g v ↔ g.has_edge u v w := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [edgesInto, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range] at h
    obtain ⟨u', hu', pair, ⟨hpair, hp1⟩, hEq⟩ := h
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hEq
    obtain ⟨hEq1, hEq2⟩ := hEq
    subst hEq1
    refine ⟨hu', pair, ?_, by simpa using hp1, by simpa using hEq2⟩
    simpa using hpair
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨hu, pair, hpair, hp1, hp2⟩ := h
    simp only [edgesInto, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]
    exact ⟨u, hu, pair, ⟨by simpa using hpair, by simpa using hp1⟩, by simp [hp2]⟩

lemma mem_inTable (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) (hv : v < g.size) :
    (u, w) ∈ (inTable g).getD v [] ↔ g.has_edge u v w := by
  rw [inTable, getD_map_range _ _ _ hv]
  exact mem_edgesInto g u v w

lemma length_iterBF (g : WeightedGraph) (tbl : List (List (Nat × Int))) (start k : Nat) :
    (iterBF g tbl start k).length = g.size := by
  cases k with
  | zero => simp [iterBF, initBF]
  | succ k => simp [iterBF, stepBF]

lemma getD_iterBF_zero (g : WeightedGraph) (tbl : List (List (Nat × Int))) (start v : Nat)
    (hv : v < g.size) :
    (iterBF g tbl start 0).getD v none = if v = start then some 0 else none := by
  simp only [iterBF, initBF]
  exact getD_map_range _ _ _ hv _

lemma getD_iterBF_succ (g : WeightedGraph) (tbl : List (List (Nat × Int))) (start v k : Nat)
    (hv : v < g.size) :
    (iterBF g tbl start (k + 1)).getD v none =
      relaxList (iterBF g tbl start k) (tbl.getD v []) ((iterBF g tbl start k).getD v none) := by
  simp only [iterBF, stepBF]
  exact getD_map_range _ _ _ hv _

end BF

/-! ### Structural lemmas about paths -/

lemma is_path_len (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (h : g.is_path p) : 0 < p.length := by
  cases p with
  | nil => simp [WeightedGraph.is_path] at h
  | cons a t => simp

lemma is_path_singleton (g : WeightedGraph) (x : Nat) : g.is_path [x] := by
  simp [WeightedGraph.is_path]

lemma weight_singleton (g : WeightedGraph) (x : Nat) (w : Int) :
    g.path_has_weight [x] w ↔ w = 0 := by
  simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]

lemma getLast?_append_cons (l1 : List Nat) (x : Nat) (l2 : List Nat) :
    (l1 ++ (x :: l2)).getLast? = (x :: l2).getLast? := by
  induction l1 with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
      cases t with
      | nil => simp
      | cons b t' => simpa using ih

lemma getLast?_snoc (l : List Nat) (a : Nat) : (l ++ [a]).getLast? = some a := by
  simp

lemma is_path_split (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (l1 : List Nat) (x : Nat) (l2 : List Nat),
    (g.is_path (l1 ++ (x :: l2)) ↔ (g.is_path (l1 ++ [x]) ∧ g.is_path (x :: l2))) := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil => intro x l2; simp [is_path_singleton g x]
  | cons a l1' ih =>
      intro x l2
      cases l1' with
      | nil =>
          simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append]
          constructor
          · intro h
            obtain ⟨_, he, hrest⟩ := h
            exact ⟨⟨by simp, he, is_path_singleton g x⟩, hrest⟩
          · intro ⟨h1, h2⟩
            obtain ⟨_, he, _⟩ := h1
            exact ⟨by simp, he, h2⟩
      | cons b t =>
          simp only [List.cons_append]
          constructor
          · intro h
            obtain ⟨_, he, hrest⟩ := h
            obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := (ih x l2).mp (by simpa using hrest)
            exact ⟨⟨by simp, he, by simpa using hA⟩, hB⟩
          · intro ⟨h1, h2⟩
            obtain ⟨_, he, hA⟩ := h1
            refine ⟨by simp, he, ?_⟩
            have := (ih x l2).mpr ⟨by simpa using hA, h2⟩
            simpa using this

lemma weight_split (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (l1 : List Nat) (x : Nat) (l2 : List Nat) (w : Int),
    (g.path_has_weight (l1 ++ (x :: l2)) w ↔
      ∃ w1 w2, g.path_has_weight (l1 ++ [x]) w1 ∧ g.path_has_weight (x :: l2) w2 ∧
        w = w1 + w2) := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil =>
      intro x l2 w
      simp only [List.nil_append]
      constructor
      · intro h; exact ⟨0, w, by simp [weight_singleton], h, by ring⟩
      · intro ⟨w1, w2, h1, h2, h3⟩
        rw [weight_singleton] at h1
        subst h1; subst h3; simpa using h2
  | cons a l1' ih =>
      intro x l2 w
      cases l1' with
      | nil =>
          simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append]
          constructor
          · intro h
            obtain ⟨we, wr, he, hr, hw⟩ := h
            exact ⟨we, wr, ⟨we, 0, he, by simp [weight_singleton], by ring⟩, hr, hw⟩
          · intro ⟨w1, w2, h1, h2, h3⟩
            obtain ⟨we, wr, he, hr, hw⟩ := h1
            rw [weight_singleton] at hr
            exact ⟨we, w2, he, h2, by omega⟩
      | cons b t =>
          simp only [List.cons_append]
          constructor
          · intro h
            obtain ⟨we, wr, he, hr, hw⟩ := h
            obtain ⟨w1, w2, hA, hB, hC⟩ := (ih x l2 wr).mp (by simpa using hr)
            exact ⟨we + w1, w2, ⟨we, w1, he, by simpa using hA, rfl⟩, hB, by omega⟩
          · intro ⟨w1, w2, h1, h2, h3⟩
            obtain ⟨we, wr, he, hr, hw⟩ := h1
            refine ⟨we, wr + w2, he, ?_, by omega⟩
            have := (ih x l2 (wr + w2)).mpr ⟨wr, w2, by simpa using hr, h2, rfl⟩
            simpa using this

lemma is_path_snoc_iff (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (q : List Nat) (u v : Nat),
    q ≠ [] → q.getLast? = some u →
    (g.is_path (q ++ [v]) ↔ (g.is_path q ∧ ∃ w, g.has_edge u v w)) := by
  intro q
  induction q with
  | nil => intro u v hq _; exact absurd rfl hq
  | cons a q' ih =>
      intro u v hq hl
      cases q' with
      | nil =>
          simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some.injEq] at hl
          subst hl
          simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
          constructor
          · intro h
            obtain ⟨_, he, _⟩ := h
            exact ⟨is_path_singleton g a, he⟩
          · intro ⟨_, he⟩
            exact ⟨by simp, he, is_path_singleton g v⟩
      | cons b t =>
          have hl' : (b :: t).getLast? = some u := by simpa using hl
          simp only [List.cons_append]
          constructor
          · intro h
            obtain ⟨_, he, hrest⟩ := h
            obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := (ih u v (by simp) hl').mp (by simpa using hrest)
            exact ⟨⟨by simp, he, hA⟩, hB⟩
          · intro ⟨h1, h2⟩
            obtain ⟨_, he, hA⟩ := h1
            refine ⟨by simp, he, ?_⟩
            have := (ih u v (by simp) hl').mpr ⟨hA, h2⟩
            simpa using this

lemma weight_snoc_iff (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (q : List Nat) (u v : Nat) (w : Int),
    q ≠ [] → q.getLast? = some u →
    (g.path_has_weight (q ++ [v]) w ↔
      ∃ x w0, g.path_has_weight q x ∧ g.has_edge u v w0 ∧ w = x + w0) := by
  intro q
  induction q with
  | nil => intro u v w hq _; exact absurd rfl hq
  | cons a q' ih =>
      intro u v w hq hl
      cases q' with
      | nil =>
          simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some.injEq] at hl
          subst hl
          simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
          constructor
          · intro h
            obtain ⟨we, wr, he, hr, hw⟩ := h
            rw [weight_singleton] at hr
            exact ⟨0, we, by simp [weight_singleton], he, by omega⟩
          · intro ⟨x, w0, hx, he, hw⟩
            rw [weight_singleton] at hx
            exact ⟨w0, 0, he, by simp [weight_singleton], by omega⟩
      | cons b t =>
          have hl' : (b :: t).getLast? = some u := by simpa using hl
          simp only [List.cons_append]
          constructor
          · intro h
            obtain ⟨we, wr, he, hr, hw⟩ := h
            obtain ⟨x, w0, hx, he0, hw0⟩ := (ih u v wr (by simp) hl').mp (by simpa using hr)
            exact ⟨we + x, w0, ⟨we, x, he, hx, rfl⟩, he0, by omega⟩
          · intro ⟨x, w0, hx, he0, hw⟩
            obtain ⟨we, wr, he, hr, hw2⟩ := hx
            refine ⟨we, wr + w0, he, ?_, by omega⟩
            have := (ih u v (wr + w0) (by simp) hl').mpr ⟨wr, w0, hr, he0, rfl⟩
            simpa using this

lemma is_path_snoc (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (u v : Nat) (w : Int)
    (hp : g.is_path p) (hl : p.getLast? = some u) (he : g.has_edge u v w) :
    g.is_path (p ++ [v]) := by
  have hne : p ≠ [] := by
    intro h; subst h; simp at hl
  exact (is_path_snoc_iff g p u v hne hl).mpr ⟨hp, w, he⟩

lemma weight_snoc (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (u v : Nat) (w0 x : Int)
    (hl : p.getLast? = some u) (hw : g.path_has_weight p x) (he : g.has_edge u v w0) :
    g.path_has_weight (p ++ [v]) (x + w0) := by
  have hne : p ≠ [] := by
    intro h; subst h; simp at hl
  exact (weight_snoc_iff g p u v (x + w0) hne hl).mpr ⟨x, w0, hw, he, rfl⟩

lemma exists_weight (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (p : List Nat), g.is_path p →
    ∃ w, g.path_has_weight p w := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro _; exact ⟨0, by simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]⟩
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro hp
      cases t with
      | nil => exact ⟨0, by simp [weight_singleton]⟩
      | cons b t' =>
          obtain ⟨_, ⟨we, he⟩, hrest⟩ := hp
          obtain ⟨wr, hwr⟩ := ih hrest
          exact ⟨we + wr, ⟨we, wr, he, hwr, rfl⟩⟩

/-- Every vertex of a path that starts inside the graph lies inside the graph. -/
lemma path_mem_lt (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (s : Nat), g.is_path p → p.head? = some s → s < g.size →
      ∀ x ∈ p, x < g.size := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro s _ h; simp at h
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro s hp hh hs x hx
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hh
      subst hh
      cases t with
      | nil => simp at hx; omega
      | cons b t' =>
          obtain ⟨_, ⟨we, he⟩, hrest⟩ := hp
          have hb : b < g.size := by
            obtain ⟨ha, pair, hpair, hp1, _⟩ := he
            have := (hwf a ha).1 pair hpair
            omega
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
          · omega
          · exact ih b hrest (by simp) hb x h

/-! ### Soundness and optimality of the relaxation rounds -/

lemma bf_sound (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hstart : start < g.size) :
    ∀ (k v : Nat) (d : Int), v < g.size →
      (BF.iterBF g (BF.inTable g) start k).getD v none = some d →
      ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧
        g.path_has_weight p d ∧ p.length ≤ k + 1 := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro v d hv h
      rw [BF.getD_iterBF_zero _ _ _ _ hv] at h
      by_cases hvs : v = start
      · subst hvs
        have hd : d = 0 := by simp at h; omega
        exact ⟨[v], is_path_singleton g v, by simp, by simp,
          by rw [weight_singleton]; omega, by simp⟩
      · simp only [if_neg hvs] at h
        exact absurd h (by simp)
  | succ k ih =>
      intro v d hv h
      rw [BF.getD_iterBF_succ _ _ _ _ _ hv] at h
      rcases BF.relaxList_cases (BF.iterBF g (BF.inTable g) start k)
          ((BF.inTable g).getD v []) ((BF.iterBF g (BF.inTable g) start k).getD v none) with
        heq | ⟨e, hmem, heq⟩
      · rw [heq] at h
        obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := ih v d hv h
        exact ⟨p, h1, h2, h3, h4, by omega⟩
      · rw [heq] at h
        obtain ⟨u, w⟩ := e
        have hedge : g.has_edge u v w := (BF.mem_inTable g u v w hv).mp hmem
        cases hx : (BF.iterBF g (BF.inTable g) start k).getD u none with
        | none =>
            rw [hx] at h
            simp only [BF.addO] at h
            exact absurd h (by simp)
        | some x =>
            rw [hx] at h
            simp only [BF.addO, Option.some.injEq] at h
            have hu : u < g.size := hedge.1
            obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := ih u x hu hx
            refine ⟨p ++ [v], is_path_snoc g p u v w h1 h3 hedge, ?_, by rw [getLast?_snoc], ?_, ?_⟩
            · cases p with
              | nil => simp at h2
              | cons a t => simpa using h2
            · rw [← h]; exact weight_snoc g p u v w x h3 h4 hedge
            · simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
              omega
